result_text:
Cancelled purchase orders are now excluded from the per-rep purchase-order count, so Anna's example would show Anna 2, Bob 1.

- **`src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`** (`findPurchaseOrderCountPerSalesRep`, around line 6518): added `AND po.status <> 'CANCELLED'` to the purchase-order subquery, the same filter the other per-rep counts and the category query use. The Javadoc now says cancelled orders are not counted.
- **`src/test/java/com/acme/backoffice/SalesRepPurchaseOrderCountTest.java`**: added `cancelledPurchaseOrdersAreNotCounted`, which creates two cancelled January orders for the South warehouse and expects Anna:1, Bob:1. The existing test had no cancelled case, so nothing covered this before.

`SalesRepPurchaseOrderCountTest` passes (4 tests). I didn't run the new test against the unfixed code to confirm it fails there. Nothing is committed.
